# `scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/production/setup_production.py`

Source: [setup_production.py](../../../../../scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/production/setup_production.py)

```text
setup_production.py: set up Sahyadri production runs (pkdgrav3 -> Rockstar -> consistent-trees -> .vahc -> FITS)
on pawna. It only creates directories and writes configuration files and a submit script; nothing is submitted.
Check the files, adjust them if needed, then run the submit script it prints.

Layout (ROOT = the working area while the run is computed, default /user/$USER/sahyadri_scratch (home: ~10x the
write speed of /storage); ARCHIVE = the long-term copy of the kept data, default /storage/$USER/sahyadri_sims, same
layout, read-only once checked (retention.py, archive_run.py); SIM = Sahyadri_L<L>N<N>; COSMO = <cosmology><N>):
  ROOT/sims/SIM/COSMO/            cosmology.txt, outputs_a.txt, transfer_pkdgrav3.dat, class_pk_z<zstart>.dat
  ROOT/sims/SIM/COSMO/r<R>/       run.conf (pipeline), p.par (pkdgrav3), output_steps.txt, submit.sh, README.txt,
                                  logs/ (job logs), checkpoints/, compressed/ (snap.<step>.s<pct>.<w>.pkc)
  ROOT/halos/SIM/COSMO/r<R>/      rockstar_input.cfg (Rockstar), README.txt; later out_<snap>.trees, .vahc, .tens,
                                  trees/, compressed/*.fits.gz
  ROOT/halos/SIM/COSMO/scales.txt written by the ctrees stage

Simulation settings:
  cosmology    cosmologies/<name>.cosmo (default: the Sahyadri default, as pegasus production)
  ICs          pkdgrav3 2LPT at z = Z_START (49) from the CLASS P(k) at Z_START that pegasus production gave
               NGenIC: transfer_pkdgrav3.dat = sqrt(P/k^ns), with dSigma8 chosen so that pkdgrav3 reproduces that
               P(k) at Z_START (pkdgrav3 scales dSigma8 by its own growth D(a_start)/D(1))
  gravity      as /storage/swarajit/pkdgrav3_sims/pkdgrav3_n256_gadget4ic_v4_corrected/examples/cosmology_test.par:
               dSoft = 1/60 of the mean particle spacing (comoving), dEta = 0.3 with bEpsAccStep (adaptive steps),
               dTheta = classic_theta_switch(), nReplicas = classic_replicas_switch(), Ewald, bNewKDK
  time steps   top-level steps of about the same size in a as that run (STEP_DA = 4.6154e-4 =
               (1 - 1/13)/2000), i.e. round(delta a / STEP_DA) steps between outputs; ~2120 in total
  outputs      the scale factors in sahyadri_outputs_a.txt (101, z = 11.98 ... 0; the last is z = 0 exactly)
  potential    stored (dCompPotStep = 100 (km/s)^2) in every snapshot at z <= 0.5
  memory       bMemIntegerPosition = True (positions as 32-bit integers, 36 B per particle; ~0.78 x the memory of
               doubles; 512^3 test 24 Nov 2026: P(k) within 1e-3 to k = 4 h/Mpc, halo mass function within 0.3 %);
               --no-int-pos for doubles. Checkpoints keep the layout: restarts use the setting they were made with
  checkpoints  every CHECK_INTERVAL steps to r<R>/checkpoints (newest 2 kept); pkdgrav3 stops cleanly 1-4 h before
               the PBS wall time (iWallRunTime); continue with `submit.sh restart`
  I/O          staged (pkdgrav3 tools/staging/run_staged.pbs): snapshots and checkpoints go to the node's local SSD
               and are copied to NFS while the simulation runs (SIM_STAGING=1 in run.conf)

  --schedule [P]  also register every realisation with the run manager (tools/sahyadri_manager, must be running)
                  and put its simulation in the manager's queue with priority P (default 0; lower runs first); the
                  manager submits them within max_sim_running / max_sim_queued
usage: setup_production.py [--schedule [P]] [--root DIR] [--archive DIR|''] [--keep-full-z "0 0.05 ... 4.9089"] [--keep-pct 9] [--L 200] [--N 1024] [--cosmo default|a,b|var_*|all] [--real 1|1,2|1-5]
                           [--codes DIR] [--pkd-io-root DIR] [--step-da 4.6154e-4] [--check-interval 250] [--force]
Run with the pipeline's Python (numpy, scipy), e.g. /storage/shadab/pipeline_test/codes/venv/bin/python.
```

## Contents

- [`read_cosmo`](#read_cosmo) - Read `cosmologies/<name>.cosmo` (`KEY = value` lines; COMMENT lines kept whole) into a dict.
- [`reals_of`](#reals_of) - Expand a realisation list like `'1-3,7'` to `[1, 2, 3, 7]`.
- [`seed_of`](#seed_of) - Initial-condition seed of realisation `r` from `config/sims/seeds.txt` (exits if missing).
- [`dark_energy`](#dark_energy) - (w0, wa) of a cosmology file; (-1, 0) is a cosmological constant.
- [`growth`](#growth) - Linear growth D(a) for matter + curvature + (w0, wa) dark energy, no radiation, as pkdgrav3 integrates it (H from csmExp2Hub; growth ODE of csmComoveGrowth). Same function as the P(k) checks (class\_pk.growth).
- [`ic_spectrum`](#ic_spectrum) - pkdgrav3 transfer table and dSigma8 that reproduce the CLASS P(k) at Z\_START.
- [`steps_plan`](#steps_plan) - Number of pkdgrav3 steps per output interval and the cumulative step of each output.
- [`rockstar_mem`](#rockstar_mem) - PBS memory for Rockstar: 1.7 x its particle array (32 B per particle) + 8 GB, rounded up to 16 GB. Measured peak 1.75-1.9 x the array at 512^3 (16-64 writers, two z~0 snapshots, pawna job 2536781; 7.1-8.5 GB in all 11 batches of L200N512, z = 12 to 0, no trend with z): particles, their overlap copies (+26% at 16 writers, +40% at 64) and an 8-byte FoF index per particle, plus the previous snapshot's halos. At 2048^3 (64 writers, 32 readers, pawna, L200N2048 r3-r5 batches of snapshots 0-34, 18-19 Nov 2026): 422-430 GB = 1.56 x the array. 128^3: 16gb, 512^3: 16gb, 1024^3: 80gb, 2048^3: 480gb (was 2.2 x: 624gb; at 480gb a 250 GB vahc job fits on the same 755 GB pawna node).
- [`verify_resources`](#verify_resources) - Stage verify (verify\_run.py; + KEPT\_FILES.json checksums on swarm/pegasus): (cores, mem, wall, pkc\_check at once). pkc\_check is CPU-bound (decompression); measured 20 Nov 2026 on pegasus (debug node, 32 cores, Lustre, r2 2048^3 snapshots of 54-59 GB): 1 snapshot x 8 threads 1127 s, 1 x 32 threads 350 s, 4 x 8 threads 795 s for 4, 2 x 16 threads 297 s for 2 (best: 13 kept snapshots ~35 min); 1.1-1.2 GB per pkc\_check. SHA-256: 1.1 GB/s one file at a time, 4.8 GB/s with 8 threads (archive\_run.py's code), ~3.6 TB kept at 2048^3 -&gt; ~13 min. The halo checks read headers and binary ID columns: minutes. Up to 512^3 the old defaults (verify measured 490 s at 512^3).
- [`parquet_resources`](#parquet_resources) - Stage parquet (fits\_to\_parquet.py, streams in row blocks: ~1 GB per process at most). Measured on pawna, L500N512: 13.7 GB of FITS in 156 s on 8 processes (631 CPU-s; the tree file alone 155 s, one process). The halo rows grow ~8x per factor 8 in particles at fixed box; the tree file is converted by one process (gzip is sequential).
- [`resources`](#resources) - Default PBS resources by size (edit run.conf to change). Measured: 512^3 sim 25 GB / 80 min on 64 cores for 60 steps; Rockstar see rockstar\_mem (one writer per core: 64 writers 2.9x faster than 16 at 512^3 with the output on the node's disk); .vahc PP\_NPROC x ~13 GB at grid 512 (26 GB with PP\_FAST=0).
- [`resources_pegasus`](#resources_pegasus) - pegasus: 32-core nodes (385 GB Skylake hpc001-060; 514 GB Ice Lake / Sapphire Rapids hpc061-100, debug queue on hpc081+), no node-local staging. Simulation with 2 MPI ranks per node (16 threads each), as pkdgrav3's pegasus tests; 3 nodes from 1024^3. Wall times: 96 h (project queue), at most 4 h in the debug queue.
- [`resources_swarm`](#resources_swarm) - swarm: 12 nodes x 64 Ice Lake cores (Xeon 8358), 504 GB, shared between jobs; 72 h at most; Lustre /user1. Simulation with 2 MPI ranks per node; one node (32 cores, free cores of a shared node) up to 512^3, a whole node at 1024^3, 2 whole nodes at 2048^3 (~785 GB). Rockstar over shared nodes where one cannot hold it (RS\_NODES, RS\_PLACE=scatter): 2048^3 -&gt; 2 nodes. Measured (17 Nov 2026, 512^3 restart at z = 0.06): 24.5 s/step on 32 cores, 11.9 s on 2 x 32 (2.06x); Rockstar on 2 shared nodes as fast as on one, memory split evenly.
- [`fmt_l`](#fmt_l) - Box size for run names: `200` for 200.0, `12p5` for 12.5.
- [`same_content`](#same_content) - path exists and holds text, apart from '#' comment lines (the set-up time).
- [`write_shared`](#write_shared) - A file of the set-up directory, shared by its realisations (archived with each run): left untouched (and its mtime with it) when only its comments would change, so setting up another realisation does not make the kept files of the runs already verified or archived look changed.
- [`write`](#write) - Write `text` to `path` with permissions `mode`; exits if it exists unless `force`.
- [`site_block`](#site_block) - run.conf lines that depend on the site.
- [`schedule_run`](#schedule_run) - Register `conf` with the running run manager and queue its simulation (through the manager's socket).
- [`main`](#main) - Command line (argparse, see `--help`): set up the directories and configuration files of production runs for the given box, particle number, cosmologies and realisations on a site.
- [`cosmo_names`](#cosmo_names) - 'default', 'a,b', 'var\_\*', 'all' -&gt; cosmology names (cosmologies/&lt;name&gt;.cosmo), in the order given.
- [`setup_cosmo`](#setup_cosmo) - Set up every realisation of cosmology `cosmo` for the parsed arguments `a`.

## growth

```python
growth(a, c)
```

Linear growth D(a) for matter + curvature + (w0, wa) dark energy, no radiation, as pkdgrav3 integrates it
(H from csmExp2Hub; growth ODE of csmComoveGrowth). Same function as the P(k) checks (class\_pk.growth).

## ic_spectrum

```python
ic_spectrum(c)
```

pkdgrav3 transfer table and dSigma8 that reproduce the CLASS P(k) at Z\_START.

pkdgrav3 (ic/ic.cxx PowerTransfer): P(k) = norm k^ns T(k)^2 with ln T a natural cubic spline in ln k, and
norm = (dSigma8 D(a)/D(1))^2 / var8, var8 its integral over the table's k range. So T = sqrt(P\_class / k^ns)
and dSigma8 = sigma8(P\_class at Z\_START, same k range and spline) x D(1)/D(a\_start).

## steps_plan

```python
steps_plan(a_out, a_start, step_da)
```

Number of pkdgrav3 steps per output interval and the cumulative step of each output.

`a_out`: scale factors of the outputs; `a_start`: initial a; `step_da`: target step in a (at least one
step per interval). Returns `(steps per interval, step number of each output)`.

## setup_cosmo

```python
setup_cosmo(a, cosmo)
```

Set up every realisation of cosmology `cosmo` for the parsed arguments `a`.

For each realisation writes, in the simulation directory: `p.par` (pkdgrav3 parameters), `output_steps.txt`
(step, a, z of each output), `run.conf` (pipeline configuration), `submit.sh`, `postprocess.sh` and
`README.txt`; in the halo directory: `rockstar_input.cfg` and `README.txt`. Also derives the run's
memory estimate, retention and resource requests (see the module docstring).
